# Spells #532 fixtures

These inert source snapshots cover exactly the 100 roots in ticket #532 and their declared supporting Spell context. `provenance.json` identifies the complete pinned root, dependency, class lookup, manifest, bibliography and PCGen comparison bytes. Class records supply list-tag lookup context only and are not selected definitions. Empty pack directories are represented by `.gitkeep` files; reconstruction uses portable `TMPDIR` scratch.

The owning review is `scripts/catalog/legal/spells-532.json`. Every root is held, with unresolved content-bound attribution; no fixture grants admission. `preview.json` has the selected 100-entry scope. `binding-preview.json` has the complete declared 255-Spell context. Context removes selection-only missing dependencies but leaves two existing Journal-link importer failures. These are distinct from attribution holds and independent calculation gaps.

`preserved.json` freezes all prior raw and schema values, original canonical serialization, 7,571 historical fixture bytes and all prior legal JSON bytes at `ca1f21c07ca8d17583ac5b00a24ad812712f5583`. `protected-context.json` records the independently reconstructed union of every historical context/covered definition, including held dependencies. Its 25 overlapping current roots retain empty optional outputs and diagnostics while their full bodies and independent mechanics remain in the owning inventory.

Only root rules and explicit direct governing bases become Notes; selected alternatives and root exceptions are stated in each supporting chunk. Incidental and recursive references stay audit-only. A missing Monkey Swarm body and the literal `longarmACG` identity mismatch are explicit boundaries. Complete source hashes and publication minima do not prove complete origin or notice-chain approval.

The tests drive the public Character Sheet resolver, isolated saved Spell collections, authorization failures and transported release/legal readback. Recorded Spells grant no passive Modifiers. Literal numeric text assertions demonstrate preservation only; they do not demonstrate execution of a running Spell Effect. No production state is written.

`verification.json` preserves the completed source proof at its exact scope. `local-binding-proof.json` independently checks all 34 opt-in local CRB conditions against the exact original/current input bytes, approved bindings, admissions and public legal data. `historical-binding-proof.json` combines 3,797 source and 34 local bindings: all 3,831 historical rows, with no omissions.
